record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, construct f_i=log1p(training_count_i)/max_j log1p(training_count_j) using training interactions only. Multiply historical item embeddings by 1-0.3*f_i before adding the unchanged positional and prefix-length contributions; keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This fixed input feature may reduce common-item dominance alongside the current pointwise loss. Preserve learned embedding design, backbone topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Store frequency values as checkpoint buffers and reproduce the transformation through the predictor writer, with one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Test whether attenuating common historical items improves validation HR@10 alongside the existing pointwise loss and prefix-length feature. Compute normalized log-frequency solely from each category's training interactions and scale historical item embeddings by 1-0.3*f_i. Keep candidate embeddings, learned parameters, causal backbone, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged.
